Congress Offers Maharashtra CM Post to BJP's Pankaja Munde

Congress leaders have extended an open offer to Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) leader Pankaja Munde, inviting her to join their party. The offer includes a promise to help her become the first female Chief Minister of Maharashtra. This offer was reportedly made by a Congress leader to Munde, who is currently a minister in the Maharashtra government.
